messages:
Zara: Quick follow-up from the quant sync 1 — running into weird failures on degenerate inputs (long repeats, extreme token id sparsity). Thinking we need explicit manifesto entries for "degenerate_profile" and mitigation hints. Anyone seen this in canaries?
Ken: Yep. FP8 headwise saturates on long repeated tokens, attention scores blow up and late tokens go off-distribution. We observed 3x increase in early_fallback_rate on a small adversarial corpus.
Miguel: Data point: int8 actually behaved better on one of our repeat-heavy prompt sets because sign preservation was more stable after per-channel scaling. But int8 cost/profile different.
Priya: Proposal: manifest add-ins: "degenerate_profiles": list of named test vectors + expected safe_precision, "degenerate_thresholds": {repeat_run: N, sparsity: P}, and a pointer to quick mitigation (e.g., request-level preprocessing).
Zara: Example mitigation in runtime: if repeat_run > N, apply token-deduping preprocessor with a rule severity=soft|hard. soft = annotate and let model handle, hard = collapse runs. Need to record when we applied it in telemetry.
Ken: Also: add a "calibration_shape_matrix" hint in the manifest. Some models only degrade for specific shape combos (seq_len x batch) under 4bit. Compiler can use that to avoid compiling a lowbit kernel for unsupported shapes.
Miguel: Important: add a regression tombstone in validation_artifact: include a small unit test harness that runs 20 degenerate vectors and checks loss_delta < X. Store artifact hash in manifest so CI ties to manifest.
Priya: UX for customers: expose a simple flag "degenerate_mitigation=auto|off|warn" in requests. Default auto applies soft fixes. If off, we must return a machine-friendly warning code (DEGENERATE_RISK) plus suggested mitigations.
Zara: Billing/legal: we must decide whether regeneration or extra corrective passes bill as normal tokens; probably yes, but document it. Also surface estimated cost_multiplier for degenerate paths in the manifest.
Ken: Observability: emit DEGENERATE_PROFILE_TRIGGER (profile_name, metric: repeat_run or sparsity, chosen_mitigation, resulting_precision). Use that to tune allowed_overrides.
Miguel: Edge-case: multimodal inputs where image-derived tokens create long zero-padding runs; manifest should allow per-modality exceptions (e.g., allow more permissive sparsity for image prompts).
Priya: Action items: Zara 5 draft manifest schema additions (degenerate_profiles, calibration_shape_matrix, cost_multiplier), Miguel 5 add unit test harness + validation artifact spec, Ken 5 telemetry/event spec + error codes, I'll draft customer flag semantics and billing note.
canary-bot: RFC stub created: /rfc/degenerate-inputs-quant-mitigation-v1 5 reviewers: Zara, Ken, Miguel, Priya
